status: Fixed configurations retained from the original controlled evaluation.
question: Exact compact processing of joint recorded-indicator comparisons under bounded linkage changes

task.source_indicators: Three fixed source indicators per database; see docs/joint-queries.md.
task.condition: all six absolute recorded rate contrasts are within the specified tolerance
task.tolerance_justification: investigator-specified sensitivity settings of 5 and 10 percentage points, inherited diagnostics; neither clinical standards nor significance thresholds
task.output: minimum changed proposed pairs to reverse this Boolean condition, attaining permutation, independently checked feasible values and rigorous lower bracket where available
task.support: complete balanced rosters; additional complete within-hospital blocks when visible hospital labels on both sides retain the known reference matching

data.MIMIC: the first two existing 40-train/60-test person splits, seeds 101201 and 101202
data.eICU: natural within-admission 30-train/225-test roster, separate-admission 18-person control, and existing 100-train/128-test roster
data.corruptions: base and shifted for MIMIC and 128-person eICU; new frozen seeds 2026110400 plus case index; retain actual cross-stay profiles for the two natural controls
data.training_corruptions: base corruption only, seed 2026110310 plus roster index; never use test outcomes or keys as score features
data.dependence: all populations reused; overlapping MIMIC splits and shared eICU training remain dependent. New noise is held out from tuning but is not a new clinical cohort
data.hospital_metadata_preflight: 2520 unit stays, 186 hospitals, no missing hospital IDs; all 255 prepared natural pairs retain hospital. This check used identifiers only, not query outcomes

point_proposals.logistic_tuning: lambda in [0.1,1,10], first 75 percent of a fixed random person split for fitting and remaining persons for validation; balanced pair log loss; refit on all training people
point_proposals.gold_information: same known training correspondences; cross-person negatives implied by the complete training roster; count original known matches, not all implied negative pairs
point_proposals.features: same age-agreement bins and categorical equality/missingness bins; no query flags, identity keys or test labels

comparisons: profile-compressed integer transport with free baseline-cell capacity and unit-cost overflow
matching-restricted MES negative log likelihood with common epsilon=0.1 and n proposed-positive pair labels; explicit mathematical adaptation, not reproduction of published software
exact independent-condition radii under the same complete/block-complete support

evidence_and_cost.audit_baselines: exact finite-population upper-error test allowing observed errors versus zero-error-only acceptance, at alpha=0.05; sample fractions 0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,1; use checked lower radius bounds for assurance
evidence_and_cost.uncertainty: exact conditional sample probabilities; paired per-instance timing medians/ranges across repetitions; no independent-patient confidence interval from overlapping rosters

checks: integer LP dual-bound checker including corruption rejection
